name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
title: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd - 542759 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Spandana returned to profit (PAT ₹5 cr vs ₹95 cr loss) with AUM up 12% QoQ to ₹4,420 cr and X-bucket CE 99.7%; FY27 exit AUM target ₹6,500 cr needs disbursals to rise to ₹550-600 cr/month.

triggers.label: AUM ₹3,948 cr → ₹4,420 cr QoQ
triggers.quote: AUM closing was INR4,420 crores, which is higher compared to last quarter AUM of INR3,948 crores.

triggers.label: Cost of borrowing down 120 bps to 12%
triggers.quote: We have seen marginal cost of borrowings reduce during the quarter by 120 basis points, it is stacking at 12%.

triggers.label: FY27 exit AUM ₹6,500 cr
triggers.quote: I spoke of, March '27, we are likely to exit at INR6,500 crores of AUM.

triggers.label: NIM contracted 11.1% → 9.9%
triggers.quote: NIM contracted to 9.9% compared to 11.1% largely on the impact of cost of borrowings

triggers.label: Rejection rates still 60-65%
triggers.quote: Rejections continue to be in the range of 60% to 65%, and it may remain so for a while.

guidance.quote: we should be closer to about INR 6,500 crores AUM by FY 27

guidance.value: ₹500 cr held for 3-4 months, then ₹550-600 cr
guidance.quote: we want to retain at that level for at least next three -four months and then aim for about INR550 crores to about INR600 crores
overall for the year, we believe it should be, below 12.5%

guidance.value: aim to be in the black, no numeric guidance
guidance.quote: for profitability, no guidance, but yes, we aim to be in the black.
in the medium term, it should come down to about 7% to 8% opex to AUM
It has to be 99.5%, I can understand some months hovering between 99.3% and 99.5%

red_flags.label: Rejection rates 60-65%; new-book growth reliant on higher disbursals
red_flags.quote: Rejections continue to be in the range of 60% to 65%, and it may remain so for a while.

red_flags.label: Individual loan product outside SRO guardrails
red_flags.quote: So, you need not adhere to the SRO guidelines.

evasions.quote: for profitability, no guidance, but yes, we aim to be in the black.
